Open #5713 is related to fleet-dispatch but is a separate CLI flag-parser issue, not an owner or duplicate. The follow-up should add authenticated read-only `GET /v1/tasks/:id` and, if the OpenCode API supports a safe lookup, `GET /v1/sessions/:id`; return a deliberate safe field projection (not the full task payload), cover auth/not-found/malformed-id behavior, and update README/install.sh token-source documentation.
